job.job_description:
Role & responsibilities

Good Understanding of LLMs and Gen AI technologies. (Azure Open AI, Lang Chain etc.)
Experience in Agentic AI and its architecture.
Reactive Machines
Limited Memory AI
Theory of Mind AI
Self-aware AI
Create and refine prompts that guide gen AI models to produce accurate and relevant outputs.
Ensure prompts align with project objectives and user needs.
Work with data scientists and AI developers to fine-tune model parameters based on prompt effectiveness.
Implement strategies to improve model responses.
Develop transformative AI/ML solutions to address our clients' business requirements and challenges
Project Delivery - This would entail successful delivery of projects involving data Pre-processing, Model Training and Evaluation, Parameter Tuning
Excellent knowledge on Python
Understanding business objectives and developing models that help to achieve them, along with metrics to track their progress.
Experience in AI/ML Architecture .
Verifying data quality, and/or ensuring it via data cleaning
Defining validation strategies & data augmentation pipelines
Designing, developing, and researching Machine Learning systems, models, and schemes
Good working knowledge on deep learning and advanced NLP techniques
Analysing the use cases of ML algorithms and ranking them by their success probability • Should be excellent with Rasa Framework or any other chatbot interface.
Performing statistical analysis and using results to improve models.
Training and retraining ML systems and models in real-world situations
Visualizing data for deeper insights
Hands-On with Service / Incident Management tools: JIRA / ServiceNow
Exposure to cloud platform (AWS/Azure)



Minimum Qualifications

Strong understanding of statistical methods and their applications
Experience in Machine Learning methodologies (Supervised/Unsupervised)
Apply statistical techniques to analyze data and generate actionable insights.
Systems Engineering with relevant experience in Text Mining / Natural Language Processing (NLP) tools, Data sciences, Big Data and algorithms
Certifications in AI/ML or GenAI (optional to have certification)
Familiarity with Generative AI technologies, Design and Implement GenAI Solutions
Collaborate with service line teams to design, implement and manage Gen-AI solution
Deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Keras, Torch, Theano Technology
Very good python, SQL programming skills. Java programming skills a plus
AI and GenAI
